subject.title: fix(tlon): bound stalled inbound and outbound media header waits

question: Should Tlon use the established 120-second channel-media response-header deadline, or a longer Tlon-specific deadline such as the competing 15-minute proposal?
rationale: Both values correctly bound the stall but intentionally choose different failure latency and slow-header compatibility behavior; sibling precedent supports 120 seconds, while no explicit Tlon-specific duration contract was found.

options.title: Use 120 seconds
options.body: Merge this narrow patch and align Tlon with the existing Telegram media header-timeout policy.

options.title: Use a longer deadline
options.body: Adjust this PR or the broader shared-media PR to an explicitly approved Tlon-specific duration before landing.

recommendation.title: Use 120 seconds
recommendation.body: Merge this narrow patch and align Tlon with the existing Telegram media header-timeout policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history most directly connects this person to the affected Tlon media and image-upload behavior.
